name: loidolt-theme
description: The shared Svelte design system for Loidolt applications

scripts.build: npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-tokens && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-styles && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-svelte && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-catalog
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-tokens && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-styles && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-svelte
scripts.check: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build -w @loidolt/theme-catalog
